beats.display_text: Here's a sentence. The meeting was really productive. You read it back, and something feels off. Maybe it's the word. Maybe it's the whole sentence.
beats.spoken_text: Here's a sentence. The meeting was really productive. You read it back, and something feels off. Maybe it's the word. Maybe it's the whole sentence.

beats.display_text: Most editors give you exactly two moves. Keep it, or delete it.
beats.spoken_text: Most editors give you exactly two moves. Keep it, or delete it.

beats.display_text: Delete it, and your first try is gone for good. Keep it, and the better version may never get written. Either way, you have to decide before you've finished thinking.
beats.spoken_text: Delete it, and your first try is gone for good. Keep it, and the better version may never get written. Either way, you have to decide before you've finished thinking.

beats.display_text: Write-on gives you a third move. Keep both.
beats.spoken_text: Write On gives you a third move. Keep both.

beats.display_text: This is a short orientation, not a manual. Write-on is meant to bend to the way you think, not the other way round.
beats.spoken_text: This is a short orientation, not a manual. Write On is meant to bend to the way you think, not the other way round.

beats.display_text: But four ideas make it click much faster, especially if your hands already know another editor by heart.
beats.spoken_text: But four ideas make it click much faster, especially if your hands already know another editor by heart.

beats.display_text: Idea one comes from Jason Fried's Write_On. Not version control, but alternative control.
beats.spoken_text: Idea one comes from Jason Fried's Write On. Not version control, but alternative control.

beats.display_text: Version control thinks in time: snapshots of the whole document, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. To find an old phrasing, you dig through the past.
beats.spoken_text: Version control thinks in time: snapshots of the whole document, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. To find an old phrasing, you dig through the past.

beats.display_text: Alternative control thinks in place. The other ways of saying this one line live right underneath it.
beats.spoken_text: Alternative control thinks in place. The other ways of saying this one line live right underneath it.

beats.display_text: Put the caret on a word and press Ctrl+Shift+A. Now that word can hold variants.
beats.spoken_text: Put the caret on a word and press Control Shift A. Now that word can hold variants.

beats.display_text: Hover and press the arrow keys, and you read each option in context, in the sentence where it has to live.
beats.spoken_text: Hover and press the arrow keys, and you read each option in context, in the sentence where it has to live.

beats.display_text: It works at three sizes, which Write-on calls grains. A word gets a thin violet wave. A sentence, a lower rose wave. A paragraph, a copper bar in the margin.
beats.spoken_text: It works at three sizes, which Write On calls grains. A word gets a thin violet wave. A sentence, a lower rose wave. A paragraph, a copper bar in the margin.

beats.display_text: And flipping between variants is not an edit. Nothing is lost, and there's nothing to undo.
beats.spoken_text: And flipping between variants is not an edit. Nothing is lost, and there's nothing to undo.

beats.display_text: Idea two. Delete is a cliff. Write-on adds two gentler slopes before it.
beats.spoken_text: Idea two. Delete is a cliff. Write On adds two gentler slopes before it.

beats.display_text: The first is Ghost. Press Ctrl+/ and the text fades almost to nothing, but stays exactly where it was.
beats.spoken_text: The first is Ghost. Press Control slash and the text fades almost to nothing, but stays exactly where it was.

beats.display_text: Now you can read the paragraph as if it were gone. If it reads better, leave it ghosted. If not, bring it back.
beats.spoken_text: Now you can read the paragraph as if it were gone. If it reads better, leave it ghosted. If not, bring it back.

beats.display_text: The second is Overflow. A line you love, but that doesn't belong here, goes to the side with Ctrl+Shift+X, and waits until you want it back.
beats.spoken_text: The second is Overflow. A line you love, but that doesn't belong here, goes to the side with Control Shift X, and waits until you want it back.

beats.display_text: So instead of keep or delete, you get a dial. Keep it, hold a variant, ghost it, overflow it, and only then, delete.
beats.spoken_text: So instead of keep or delete, you get a dial. Keep it, hold a variant, ghost it, overflow it, and only then, delete.

beats.display_text: Idea three is a small vocabulary. The colours always mean the same thing. Green is kept. Amber is undecided. Red is rejected.
beats.spoken_text: Idea three is a small vocabulary. The colours always mean the same thing. Green is kept. Amber is undecided. Red is rejected.

beats.display_text: Every choice you make lands on a timeline, which opens with Ctrl+Shift+L.
beats.spoken_text: Every choice you make lands on a timeline, which opens with Control Shift L.

beats.display_text: Zoom out and you see the shape of a session, bursts of drafting, stretches of cutting. Zoom in and each moment shows what changed.
beats.spoken_text: Zoom out and you see the shape of a session, bursts of drafting, stretches of cutting. Zoom in and each moment shows what changed.

beats.display_text: You can replay a piece being written, then click any moment and start editing from there.
beats.spoken_text: You can replay a piece being written, then click any moment and start editing from there.

beats.display_text: Idea four is the mental model. A draft isn't one line of text. It's a tree of possibilities, and you decide when each branch closes. Or whether it ever does.
beats.spoken_text: Idea four is the mental model. A draft isn't one line of text. It's a tree of possibilities, and you decide when each branch closes. Or whether it ever does.

beats.display_text: That gives you three habits. When you're torn between two phrasings, don't choose yet. Add a variant.
beats.spoken_text: That gives you three habits. When you're torn between two phrasings, don't choose yet. Add a variant.

beats.display_text: When you're unsure a line belongs, ghost it instead of deleting it.
beats.spoken_text: When you're unsure a line belongs, ghost it instead of deleting it.

beats.display_text: And when you love a line that doesn't fit, send it to Overflow.
beats.spoken_text: And when you love a line that doesn't fit, send it to Overflow.

beats.display_text: Your first minute: Write-on opens in read mode, just your words and a word count. Press Ctrl+Shift+R to bring the tools in. The question mark brings this video back.
beats.spoken_text: Your first minute: Write On opens in read mode, just your words and a word count. Press Control Shift R to bring the tools in. The question mark brings this video back.

beats.display_text: Then write the way you always do. Reach for these tools only at the moment you feel the urge to delete.
beats.spoken_text: Then write the way you always do. Reach for these tools only at the moment you feel the urge to delete.

beats.display_text: Why does this matter? Because every flip, ghost and stash is a small decision, and your decisions are a trace of how you think.
beats.spoken_text: Why does this matter? Because every flip, ghost and stash is a small decision, and your decisions are a trace of how you think.

beats.display_text: If you pick the shorter variant eight times out of ten, that's a pattern, and it belongs to you.

beats.display_text: To be clear about what exists: today, Write-on is the workbench, these tools with no AI at all, and your writing stays in your browser and your own files. Next, we plan to learn from your choices and past writing, with quiet nudges that ask questions, and editor personas who critique.

beats.display_text: One thing won't change: it never writes the piece for you. It keeps every option within reach, and learns to ask better questions.

beats.display_text: So the next time you reach for delete, pause, and keep both. Write on.
